visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair and glasses wearing a green T-shirt stands in a brightly lit kitchen, speaking directly to the camera with varied facial expressions. To his left, a woman with black hair in a ponytail and a striped shirt is actively stirring a pale, dough-like mixture in a large glass bowl on a wooden countertop. The background features clean white walls and wooden shelves with various kitchen items. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of the bowl, showing the texture of the mixture as it is being stirred by the woman. (3) The man continues his monologue, gesturing toward the bowl while the woman laughs heartily, her eyes squinting behind her glasses. (4) The scene shifts to the stove area where a large stainless steel pot is visible, followed by a close-up of the mixture which has been cooked into yellowish, semi-translucent lumps. (5) Another close-up shows a clay pot filled with chunks of meat stewing in a thick, brown sauce, with a wooden spoon resting inside. (6) The man is seen tasting a small piece of the yellow food, then the video shows him and the woman sitting at a dining table, sharing the stewed meat and yellow mixture, appearing to enjoy the meal. (7) Later, the man is alone in the kitchen, standing before the camera. He pulls out a plastic bag containing a piece of fish and holds up a large, fresh white radish. (8) He begins preparing a new meal, slicing the radish into thin rounds on a wooden cutting board with a large knife. (9) He layers the radish slices in the bottom of a white ceramic clay pot, places a dark-skinned fish fillet on top, and adds sliced ginger, a spice packet, and green onions. (10) He adds various sauces from bottles using a spoon and pours in hot water before covering the pot and placing it on the stove. (11) The man then transitions to a home workout in the kitchen, performing deep squats, push-ups on the tiled floor, and high-knee running in place. During breaks, he sits at the table using a remote, appearing to watch something on an unseen screen. (12) The final scene shows a close-up of the fish and radish stew boiling vigorously in the pot. The man then serves it at the table, eating the tender fish and flavorful radish with a bowl of multi-grain rice, nodding in satisfaction as he finishes the meal.
